doc_type_description: A column in a software engineering newsletter reflecting on an AI assistant's behaviour and reasoning.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A blameless postmortem report on a production problem that includes an AI assistant's analysis of the code involved.

doc_type_description: A report written by a student for a software design course, documenting an experiment involving an AI assistant.

doc_type_description: A report written by a student for a software design course, documenting an experiment involving an AI assistant.

doc_type_description: A report written by a student for a software design course, documenting an experiment involving an AI assistant.

doc_type_description: A report written by a student for a software design course, documenting an experiment involving an AI assistant.

doc_type_description: A report written by a student for a software design course, documenting an experiment involving an AI assistant.

doc_type_description: A report written by a student for a software design course, documenting an experiment involving an AI assistant.

doc_type_description: A comment thread on an open-source project's issue tracker that cites an AI assistant's analysis.

doc_type_description: A comment thread on an open-source project's issue tracker that cites an AI assistant's analysis.

doc_type_description: A comment thread on an open-source project's issue tracker that cites an AI assistant's analysis.

doc_type_description: A comment thread on an open-source project's issue tracker that cites an AI assistant's analysis.

doc_type_description: A comment thread on an open-source project's issue tracker that cites an AI assistant's analysis.

doc_type_description: Written notes from a team retrospective that record what an AI assistant said and how the team acted on it.

doc_type_description: Written notes from a team retrospective that record what an AI assistant said and how the team acted on it.

doc_type_description: Written notes from a team retrospective that record what an AI assistant said and how the team acted on it.

doc_type_description: Written notes from a team retrospective that record what an AI assistant said and how the team acted on it.

doc_type_description: Written notes from a team retrospective that record what an AI assistant said and how the team acted on it.

doc_type_description: Written notes from a team retrospective that record what an AI assistant said and how the team acted on it.

doc_type_description: Written notes from a team retrospective that record what an AI assistant said and how the team acted on it.

doc_type_description: Written notes from a team retrospective that record what an AI assistant said and how the team acted on it.

doc_type_description: Written notes from a team retrospective that record what an AI assistant said and how the team acted on it.

doc_type_description: Written notes from a team retrospective that record what an AI assistant said and how the team acted on it.

doc_type_description: Written notes from a team retrospective that record what an AI assistant said and how the team acted on it.

doc_type_description: Written notes from a team retrospective that record what an AI assistant said and how the team acted on it.

doc_type_description: A published review comparing coding assistants, with a section on how an AI assistant handles structure and abstraction.
